start_here: Say to your AI: "Put the new titles from my titles file into the plans in plans/ and fix every card that names an old title." It runs retitle, or titles-table to show the table first.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: you hand it a titles list in the request file and it rewrites the plan files in the folder you name.
instructions: 1. Clone the Workshop checkout; only python3 is needed.
2. Write request.json: plans_folder, titles {titles: [{id, title, old_title?}]}, untitled (placeholder words), card_kind, card_prefixes, copy_from_row, copy_from_doc.
3. Say "Show me the titles table"; the AI runs assemble.py titles-table --request request.json and shows the Markdown table.
4. Say "Apply them"; the AI runs assemble.py retitle --request request.json and lists each plan's id and title; placeholders keep the old title under withdrawn_title.

worked_examples.title: Two plans retitled, one to a placeholder
worked_examples.ask: Apply the new titles to my plans and fix the cards.
worked_examples.given: From test_retitle_renames_titles_and_the_cards_that_name_them and test_a_titles_table_marks_the_untitled_and_keeps_its_columns in tools/assemble-a-plan-into-a-cut/test/test_assemble.py, run here: plan X1 titled Old Name has a note card 'Then: Old Name'; plan X2 titled Second has no segments. Titles list: X1 'New Name' (basis given), X2 'placeholder' (basis none); untitled ['placeholder'], card_kind note, card_prefixes ['Then: '], copy_from_row ['basis'], copy_from_doc ['card_state'] with card_state 'held'.
worked_examples.hands_back: retitle printed {"result": {"plans": [{"id": "X1", "title": "New Name", "basis": "given"}, {"id": "X2", "title": "placeholder", "basis": "none"}]}}. X1's card now reads 'Then: New Name' and X1 has card_state held; X2 keeps title placeholder with withdrawn_title 'Second'. titles-table on the same list (column basis) printed table lines '| ID | Title | basis |', '|---|---|---|', '| X1 | New Name | given |', '| X2 | **placeholder** | none |'.
